# Chaelin Design Studio

> London-based studio building and running lead systems (website included) for local service businesses in the US, Canada and UK. Founded by Michael Oyekola. Part of Chaelin Studios.

## Services
- Lead-ready websites (included in every plan): mobile-first, click-to-call, reviews up front, call and form tracking
- Google Business Profile and local SEO
- Review generation and display
- Lead follow-up: missed-call text back, instant lead alerts
- Google Search, Local Services Ads, Facebook and Instagram ads
- Brand identity and graphic design

## Plans
- Local Leads: from $397/month (website included, Google profile, local SEO, reviews, missed-call text back)
- Leads + Ads: from $797/month plus ad spend (adds Google & Meta ads, landing pages)
- Growth: from $1,497/month plus ad spend (adds more campaigns, retargeting, monthly pages, strategy call)
- No build fee. 3-month minimum, then month to month.

## Process
Free Lead Leak Score out of 100 (48 hours) or a free 30-minute call → plan call → build (2–3 weeks) → launch → monthly improvements and a plain-English lead report.

## Promise
On every plan: if tracked leads in the first 90 days after launch are not higher than the agreed baseline, the monthly fees for those 90 days are refunded.
